messages:
maria: hey folks :wave: quick heads-up — the 2/10 biweekly slot lands on the UK bank holiday. can we swap slots with the following week (2/17) or does that break anyone's plan?

kevin: 2/17 works for core infra, but ops has a customer demo that day. can we instead move a few low-risk changes to next train and keep the more invasive ones for 2/17? :calendar:

sam: i have the v0.9.2 -> v0.10.0 bump PRs queued. if we shift, i need a new cutoff time so i can cherry-pick the last regression fixes. current cutoff is `2026-02-09T18:00Z`.

lina: +1 to sam — if we move to 2/17 pls set a hard cutoff 24h earlier so QA can run full e2e. otherwise i'm fine keeping 2/10 but will need someone to own bridge on the holiday.

maria: sounds reasonable. two options: A) keep 2/10 and we assign a bridge owner for the holiday, or B) move to 2/17 and set cutoff to `2026-02-16T18:00Z`. which is less pain?

kevin: ops prefers B (move), avoids on-call time. but we need a small window to run canaries before the customer demo on 2/18. canary window of 2 hours is fine.

sam: if we pick B i'll open an updated changelog PR and rebase the bump branch tonight. i'll also post a checklist with the exact cherry-pick commands: 
```
# example 
git checkout release/0.10
git pull
git cherry-pick <sha1>
# run quick smoke suite
```

lina: tagging `@release-coordinator` — we'll need the release calendar updated and the calendar invite moved for all bridges. also can we get a quick reminder 48h before cutoff? :bell:

release-coordinator: noted — provisional move to 2026-02-17 accepted. i've set the cutoff to `2026-02-16T18:00Z` and created a tentative calendar swap. i'll ping again at 48h and 4h before cutoff. assigning bridge owners: @kevin (primary), @maria (backup) for the 2/17 slot.

maria: thanks. sam — once you open the changelog PR i'll add a short blurb for the public notes. small ask: please put 'changelog: ready' as the top line so it's easy to find.

sam: will do. also adding a small test job to CI to ensure the version bump artifacts are produced: `ci/release:verify-artifacts`.

kevin: re: cherry-picks, i'll try to pick the fixes tomorrow morning and run quick perf traces. if anything looks off i'll flag in this thread.

deploy-bot: scheduled calendar change: release slot moved from 2026-02-10 to 2026-02-17. cutoff updated to 2026-02-16T18:00Z. bridge owners: kevin (primary), maria (backup).

lina: perfect — thanks everyone. i'll update the release playbook with the new cutoff and add the checklist items. :thumbsup:
